summary.en: Two documents side by side: cells land, the added ones in the accent; a scan line passes, the documents fill ink and their frames thicken from 2 to 7 px; stamps and hashes land, and a four-step rail marks the active step.
summary.zh: 两份文档并排：格子落下，新增的用强调色；一道扫描线扫过，文档被墨色填满、边框从 2 px 加粗到 7 px；盖章、哈希落定，下方四步进度条标出当前一步。

fits: A chapter page about something becoming fixed: a plan frozen, a version signed, a spec locked.
notFor: Documents with more than eight cells each; anything without a before and after; live editing.

intent.en: Make "it is locked now" visible: the ink fill and heavy frame turn a draft into a sealed document, and the stamp names who sealed it.
intent.zh: 让“现在锁定了”看得见：墨色填满和加粗的边框把草稿变成封存的文档，印章写明是谁封的。

content.en: Page head, two documents (title, 3–8 cells, which cells are added), a stamp and a hash each, four step names and the active step.
content.zh: 页头、两份文档（标题、3–8 格、哪些是新增）、各一个印章和哈希、四个步骤名和当前步骤。

fits.zh: 某章讲“某样东西被定下来”：计划冻结、版本签字、规格锁定。

notFor.zh: 每份文档超过八格；没有前后之分的内容；实时编辑。

pairs.note: the frozen plan runs step by step

en: Hashes are code: keep them Latin and short (≤ 12 chars) or they collide with the stamp.
zh: 哈希是代码，保持拉丁字符且短（≤ 12 字符），否则会撞上印章。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
